institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: Tafasitamab + lenalidomide

premedications.name: Tafasitamab premedication
premedications.notes: acetaminophen + antihistamine + steroid for the first infusions

supportiveCare: Lenalidomide given for up to 12 cycles, then tafasitamab continued as monotherapy until progression
monitoring: CBC (neutropenia is the main lenalidomide toxicity - the 25 mg dose is reduced for renal impairment/cytopenias)
Tafasitamab loading: weekly in cycles 1-3, then every 2 weeks

drugs.name: Tafasitamab
drugs.notes: 12 mg/kg IV. Cycle 1 also has an extra day-4 dose; days 1,8,15,22 weekly through cycle 3, then days 1,15 from cycle 4.

drugs.name: Lenalidomide
drugs.notes: 25 mg PO once daily on days 1-21 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 12 cycles. Reduce for renal impairment/cytopenias.
